answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the knoll until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the marble of the next round. What survives to the pearl is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
